newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes up on dollar sales.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes up on dollar sales.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed up against the dollar on Wednesday after selling of the U.S. currency returned following import covering, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.85 to the dollar after opening at 58.90.
"There was a little import covering which pushed down the rupee to 58.90 to the dollar, at which level sellers entered the market," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
"The dollar-rupee exchange rate is not going to rise sharply, other than if there is an exceptional demand for dollars," he said.
The central bank pushed up the dollar by 2.75 local cents, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.8308 and 59.6093.
Overnight call money, which was well offered, closed at its opening level of 9.25 percent after falling briefly to 8.75 percent.
The central bank's overnight repo rate was at 8.5 percent.
